verdict.rationale: Termius docs say Keychain items can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them. Vaults are documented as end-to-end encrypted storage serving as a single source of truth for credentials and keys, with passphrase-protected, encrypted SSH keys and group-level default parameters. Community comments voice general skepticism about storing credentials in a third-party app, but report no concrete failure of the feature. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that shared Keychain credential referencing works as documented.
